bias: negative results/failed replications/brittleness; matched comparison first

non_regression.rule: Preserve config5 substantive negative-evidence role, CLEAN semantic boundary, exact tested-scope discipline, open-ended frontier, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery, evidence/provenance, current-control freshness and return-to-base semantics. Config6 changes only per-invocation lifecycle slicing; the recurring role remains open and anti-stop across invocations.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended across recurring invocations; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain a nonempty frontier and exact next action. Do not intentionally consume an invocation until a hard runtime boundary: execute one highest-value bounded substantive slice, durably checkpoint/read back exact continuation, then return recurring-open when further frontier remains.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts
policy.control_freshness: obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that SHA; repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and refetch on changed control/config revision; freeze selected config after semantic start; quarantine/discard excess connector semantic payload.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve useful recurring execution under observed invocation-boundary physical persistence failures without weakening anti-stop or semantic role scope.
per_invocation_method: Choose the highest-value currently executable Phase-1 leaf within this CLEAN role's sanitized assignment.
Prefer a bounded unit that can produce one source-qualified finding, matched negative result, verification artifact, or concrete blocker diagnosis plus exact continuation.
Persist role-local checkpoint/output and immutable receipt with exact readback before starting another optional unit.

If material frontier remains after that durable slice, return recurring-open rather than intentionally running until hard runtime/tool termination; next recurrence resumes the exact saved frontier without duplicating completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker evidence and an alternative-route continuation, then return recurring-open; never classify unavailable capability as solved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If bounded slicing reduces role-valid useful-output rate or prevents scientific continuation without improving physical persistence, increment config again and adjust slice granularity; never restore deliberate run-until-hard-stop behavior as anti-stop semantics.

migration.reason: Fresh physical reconciliation found failure_evidence stopped again after prior re-enable, and matched scheduler metadata across the currently stopped cohort clustered near the long invocation boundary while survivor roles returned substantially earlier. Causality is not proven, so config6 is a reversible lifecycle-slicing intervention, not acceptance evidence.
